title: Cut to Ribbons
caption: Soul sample riddim, a warm crackly sixties soul vocal phrase looped and pitched up, then cut to ribbons by a robotic vowel-formant wobble bass and a buzzing sawtooth lead that answer each sampled phrase. Half-time dubstep drums, dry and punchy, sparse rhythmic stutters, tight percussive gaps, growling sub bass. Each drop removes more of the sample until only a single chopped syllable is left. Tender and filthy at the same time.
